raw.details:
Overview

HACK-TO-WEEN 2026

Build • Solve • Celebrate

Not just a hackathon — it’s a spooky good opportunity!

Hack-to-Ween 2026 is a virtual Halloween-themed hackathon organized by AWS Student Builder Group, IIT Jodhpur. Bring your creativity and technical skills together to build an innovative project with a Halloween-inspired user interface.

Event Timeline

  • Registration Opens: October 24, 2026.
  • Hackathon Dates: October 31 – November 5, 2026.
  • Problem Statement Release: October 31, 2026.
  • Final Submission Deadline: As announced by the organizers.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to students interested in coding, web development, design, and technology.
  • Team size: 1–4 members.
  • Individual participation is allowed.
  • Cross-college and cross-specialization teams are subject to the organizers’ guidelines.

Theme & Project Requirements

  • Create a website, web application, or prototype with a Halloween-themed UI.
  • Focus on creativity, functionality, usability, and innovation.
  • Projects should address the released problem statement.
  • Participants must follow the official submission instructions and deadlines.

Event Format

  • Mode: Fully virtual.
  • Registration fee: Free.
  • Event duration: October 31 – November 5, 2026.

AWS Integration

  • Participants are encouraged to explore AWS services where relevant to their projects. Any complimentary AWS resources or support will be provided according to the arrangements confirmed by the organizers.

Prizes & Certificates

  • Exciting goodies for the winners.
  • Certificates for all participants who fulfill the event requirements.

Judging Criteria

  • Projects will be evaluated according to the criteria announced by the organizers, which may include:
    • Innovation and originality.
    • Technical implementation.
    • UI/UX and functionality.
    • Problem-solving and practical value.
    • Quality of the final submission.

Submission Guidelines

  • Participants must submit their project within the announced deadline. Submission requirements may include:
    • Project description and key features.
    • Live demo or demonstration video.
    • Source-code repository.
    • Screenshots or other supporting materials requested by the organizers.

Rules

  • Each team must contain 1–4 members.
  • Participants must submit original work and acknowledge third-party resources.
  • Plagiarism and fraudulent submissions are prohibited.
  • Projects must follow the Halloween UI requirement and the released problem statement.
  • Submissions received after the deadline may not be considered.
  • Participants must follow all official instructions communicated by the organizers.

Ready to code something spooky, build something extraordinary, and compete for exciting goodies?

Register for Hack-to-Ween 2026 and let the haunting begin!
